topic: What antenna design considerations minimize signal attenuation in high-noise power line environments for reliable PLC integration?
response: To minimize signal attenuation in high-noise power line environments for reliable PLC integration, consider using low-loss antenna designs such as microstrip antennas or patch antennas. These designs have lower insertion loss and are less susceptible to electromagnetic interference (EMI). Additionally, employing frequency-hopping spread spectrum techniques can help mitigate noise effects.
reference_context: The reference context discusses power line communications (PLC) challenges, including signal attenuation, distortion, and EMI due to the physical topology of power networks and load impedance fluctuations. It also mentions high bit error rates caused by electrical motors, power supplies, fluorescent lights, and radio signal interferences.
